subject: Variance explained by the spatially structured component

messages.author: 825a0084a4c6b4b2
messages.subject: Variance explained by the spatially structured component
parts:
Dear all

I've runed 2 spatial-temporal models with and without adjustment on contextual variables. I ve found association with some contextual variables while the variance explainded by the spatially structured component decreases only by 1% after runing the 2nde model with adjustment on contetual variables.
How to interpret these results ? I was expecting more than 1% !

Thank you in advance if someone could help me to interpret these results.

Kind Regards
Sabira

First model : 

temp.lin <- y ~ f( ID.dep, model="bym", graph=FRM.adj ) + f( ID.dep1, year, model="iid" ) + year + age
model.temp.lin2 <- inla( temp.lin,
                         family="poisson",
                         data = hdlo.var.eco.h,
                         E = E,
                         lincomb =all.lcs,
                         control.predictor = list( compute=TRUE ),
                         control.compute = list( dic=TRUE) )

#variance explained 
mat.marg<-matrix(NA,nrow=96,ncol=100000)
m1 <- model.temp.lin2$marginals.random$ID.dep

for (i in 1:96){
  u <- m1[[96+i]]
  mat.marg[i,]<-inla.rmarginal(100000,u)
}
var.u <- apply(mat.marg,2,var)
var.v <- inla.rmarginal(100000,inla.tmarginal(function(x) 1/x,model.temp.lin2$marginals.hyperpar$"Precision for ID.dep (iid component)"))
perc.var.u <- mean(var.u/(var.u+var.v))
perc.var.u
#0.9825439

Second model with adjustment on contextual variables

naf21.rw8<- y ~ 1 + f(ID.dep,model="bym",graph=FRM.adj) +
  f(ID.dep1,year,model="iid") +  year +  age +
  densite_Kine +   densite_chir +   densite_adress +    NAF21_C +   NAF21_F + 
  NAF21_H 
  
model.naf21.rw8<- inla(naf21.rw8,family="poisson",data=hdlo.eco,E=E,
                       lincomb=all.lcs2,
                       control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                       control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))

#variance explained
mat.marg<-matrix(NA,nrow=96,ncol=100000)
m1 <- model.naf21.rw8$marginals.random$ID.dep

for (i in 1:96){
  u <- m1[[96+i]]
  mat.marg[i,]<-inla.rmarginal(100000,u)
}
var.u <- apply(mat.marg,2,var)
var.v <- inla.rmarginal(100000,inla.tmarginal(function(x) 1/x,model.naf21.rw8$marginals.hyperpar$"Precision for ID.dep (iid component)"))
perc.var.u <- mean(var.u/(var.u+var.v))
perc.var.u
#0.9750242
